title: v5.107.6 shipped: Arc release: face-source registry, Frigate snapshot internal URL, external-URL self-check, lock-regime face-arrival corroboration, door identity follow-up, entry-area lookup fix
summary: Arc release: face-source registry, Frigate snapshot internal URL, external-URL self-check, lock-regime face-arrival corroboration, door identity follow-up, entry-area lookup fix
why: Perimeter-identity arc, part 2. Face sensors are found via the HA registry (portable, and 17 skipped cameras fixed). Perimeter snapshots finally use Frigate's best frame through the internal URL. A daily self-check catches a stale HA external URL. Face-based lock releases now need an independent same-person arrival edge. Door alerts get one quiet 'that was <name>' follow-up. The door entry-area lookup now reads the correct object.
implications: Shipped FACE-SOURCE-REGISTRY-DISCOVERY-1, PERIMETER-FRIGATE-SNAPSHOT-CAPTURE-NEVER-1, LOCK-REGIME-FACE-ARRIVAL-CORROBORATION-1, PERIMETER-IDENTITY-FOLLOWUP-1, LOCK-ENTRY-AREAS-WRONG-OBJECT-1 at v5.107.6; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.107.6.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Done when, after the arc-end restart, new files under /media/ura/snapshots carry the Frigate event-id name shape, the face-source counters show registry hits on the 29 Frigate cameras, no external_url_unreachable repair is raised, and no lock release follows a camera_face arrival without a same-person Bermuda or tracker edge within 120 s. Reopen on any violation.
